1365 / 1366: Inspector overlay 300 + 12 inset. At 1367: docked 300. Authored width stays 1440.

Toolbar column 719px → 88px, 720 / 721px → 44px. This threshold never changes the authored breakpoint.
F6 traverses regions; Tab traverses elements, Enter on selection starts keyboard resize. Focus stays visible in scrolling panels.
Inline text: Shift+Enter newline; Enter creates a new list item in lists, otherwise commits. Escape/click-out commits inline text.
Focus mode: ⌘\ hides panels and site chrome, keeps canvas toolbar and notices. Show panels restores state; Escape does not exit.
Lock/stale insertion: validate captured target immediately before commit. No silent retarget. Disabled click insertion retains refused drop feedback.
